weathercodes_subtitle: Reference with explanations for all weather codes and symbols of a Weather4Lox set

weather_categories.snow_thunderstorm: Thundersnow (lightning, thunder with snow, hail or graupel) ⛈️
weather_categories.fog: Fog, smoke, haze, sand and dust 🌫️

weather_remarks.clear: The only weather code with different labels for day and night (clear_day / clear_night). Cloud cover 0/8. Aviation (METAR) code SKC / CLR. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set. Cannot occur combined with precipitation.
weather_remarks.clear_day: Label for a clear sky during the day. See 'clear'.
weather_remarks.clear_night: Label for a clear sky at night. See 'clear'.
weather_remarks.fair: Cloud cover 1–2/8. Aviation (METAR) code FEW. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set. Cannot occur combined with precipitation.
weather_remarks.partly_cloudy: Cloud cover 3–4/8. Aviation (METAR) code SCT. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set. Cannot occur combined with precipitation.
weather_remarks.cloudy: Cloud cover 5–7/8. Aviation (METAR) code BKN. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set. Can occur with precipitation.
weather_remarks.overcast: Cloud cover 8/8. Aviation (METAR) code OVC. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set. Can occur with precipitation.
weather_remarks.cloudy_shower_1: Used for cloudy weather with light showers (short rain events). Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.cloudy_shower_2: Used for cloudy weather with showers (short rain events). Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.overcast_shower_1: Used for overcast weather with light showers (short rain events). Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_shower_2: Used for overcast weather with showers (short rain events). Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_shower_3: Used for overcast weather with heavy showers (short rain events). Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.cloudy_rain_1: Used for cloudy weather with light rain. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.cloudy_rain_2: Used for cloudy weather with rain. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.overcast_rain_1: Used for overcast weather with light rain. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_rain_2: Used for overcast weather with rain. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_rain_3: Used for overcast weather with heavy rain. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.cloudy_sleet_1: Used for cloudy weather with light sleet. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.cloudy_sleet_2: Used for cloudy weather with sleet. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.overcast_sleet_1: Used for overcast weather with light sleet. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_sleet_2: Used for overcast weather with sleet. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_sleet_3: Used for overcast weather with heavy sleet. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.cloudy_snow_1: Used for cloudy weather with light snow. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.cloudy_snow_2: Used for cloudy weather with snow. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.overcast_snow_1: Used for overcast weather with light snow. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_snow_2: Used for overcast weather with snow. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_snow_3: Used for overcast weather with heavy snow. Night symbols do not show moon phases.

weather_remarks.cloudy_freezingrain_2: Used for cloudy weather with freezing rain. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.overcast_freezingrain_1: Used for overcast weather with light freezing rain. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_freezingrain_2: Used for overcast weather with freezing rain. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_freezingrain_3: Used for overcast weather with heavy freezing rain. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.cloudy_thunderstorm_1: Used for cloudy weather with a light thunderstorm. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.cloudy_thunderstorm_2: Used for cloudy weather with a thunderstorm. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.overcast_thunderstorm_1: Used for overcast weather with a light thunderstorm. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_thunderstorm_2: Used for overcast weather with a thunderstorm. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_thunderstorm_3: Used for overcast weather with a severe thunderstorm. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.cloudy_snowthunderstorm_1: Used for cloudy weather with a light snow thunderstorm. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.cloudy_snowthunderstorm_2: Used for cloudy weather with a snow thunderstorm. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.overcast_snowthunderstorm_1: Used for overcast weather with a light snow thunderstorm. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_snowthunderstorm_2: Used for overcast weather with a snow thunderstorm. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_snowthunderstorm_3: Used for overcast weather with a severe snow thunderstorm. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_icepellets: Used for overcast weather with ice pellets (clear, 1-4mm). Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_graupel: Used for overcast weather with graupel (round white grains, 1-4mm). Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.cloudy_fog: Used for cloudy weather with light fog. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.overcast_fog: Used for overcast weather with fog. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_hail_1: Used for overcast weather with light hail. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_hail_2: Used for overcast weather with hail. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.overcast_hail_3: Used for overcast weather with heavy hail. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.mist: Light fog / haze with moist air. Visibility is 1-5 km. Night symbols may show moon phases depending on the set.
weather_remarks.smoke: Smoke particles in the air, usually from field or forest fires. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.haze: Haze / high fog. Fine dry particles (dust, salt, smoke) in the air reduce visibility. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.dust_whirls: Dust or sand whirled up by wind, without forming a full dust storm. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.fog: Fog, partly dense with high humidity. Visibility is 0-1 km. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.sand: Sandstorm or blowing sand. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.dust: Widespread dust suspended in the air. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.volcanic_ash: Particles released into the atmosphere by volcanic eruptions. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.squalls: Sudden, strong wind gusts, often associated with approaching thunderstorms. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.tornado: Violent rotating vortices reaching from the ground to a cloud. Night symbols do not show moon phases.
weather_remarks.no_data: Used when no weather data is available. The icon may indicate day/night depending on the set.
